@@U03215@@
that not even Herakles’ arrows could harm.
Their cawing is meant well;
they'd like to join us as near relations.

@@U03217@@
(As if intimidated.)

@@U03218@@
What is that hissing I hear?

@@U03220@@
You needn't be afraid of them.
They're the heads of the Lernaean Hydra.
Though missing a body,
they still think they're something.
But what’s happening to you?
Why the gestures? So restless!
Where do you want to go?
Well, go then! Wherever you want!
Craning your head like that!
Ah, I see!
That group over there. So that’s it.
Don't hold back. Go on!
Tell them what pretty faces they have;
they'll love you for it.
Those are the lamias,
clever, refined little tarts with smiling mouths
and seductive eyes—
favorites of the satyrs.
Your horse’s hoof won't be a hindrance.
Give it a try!

@@U03222@@
I trust you'll stay here, then, so I can find you?

@@U03224@@
Feel free! Go!
Mix with that airy rabble!
Being from Egypt, we're used to waiting millennia.
But never fail to respect our situation.
Enthroned before the pyramids,
translation:
@@U03215@@
即使是赫拉克勒斯的箭也无法造成伤害。
它们的叫声是善意的。
他们愿意作为近亲加入我们。

@@U03217@@
（好像被吓到了。）

@@U03218@@
我听到的嘶嘶声是什么？

@@U03220@@
你不必害怕他们。
他们是勒南九头蛇的头。
虽然失去了肉体，
他们仍然认为自己很重要。
但你怎么了？
为什么要用手势？好不安啊！
你想去哪里？
好吧，那就走吧！想去哪儿就去哪儿！
就这么伸着头！
啊，我明白了！
那边那群人就是这样。
不要退缩。继续！
告诉他们他们有多么漂亮的面孔；
他们会因此而爱你。
那些是蛇蝎美人，
聪明、精致、嘴巴微笑的小馅饼
以及充满诱惑的眼神——
色狼的最爱。
你的马蹄不会成为障碍。
尝试一下！

@@U03222@@
我相信你会留在这里，这样我就能找到你？

@@U03224@@
随意！去！
和那些轻浮的乌合之众混在一起！
来自埃及，我们习惯了等待数千年。
但永远不要不尊重我们的处境。
在金字塔前登基，
